description: SHOW BUILTIN FUNCTIONS - the built-in catalog without any UDF (live-verified): hundreds of rows all is_builtin=Y including UPPER/SUM/ROW_NUMBER; the same 21 live columns as SHOW FUNCTIONS; UDFs excluded (and LIKE on a UDF name matching nothing) while SHOW FUNCTIONS is exactly the builtins plus the user functions in scope (set algebra via CTAS over RESULT_SCAN + EXCEPT); LIKE filters; BUILTIN and USER modifiers mutually exclusive as syntax errors (engine-typed, skip snowflake as the Java did); and builtin staying an identifier. Converted 1:1 from ddl/ShowBuiltinFunctionsTest (now retired).

steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER("name")) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE UPPER("name") IN ('UPPER', 'SUM', 'ROW_NUMBER')
CREATE FUNCTION only_a_udf(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'x + 1'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE UPPER("name") = 'ONLY_A_UDF'
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE UPPER("name") = 'ONLY_A_UDF'
CREATE FUNCTION extra_udf(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'x + 1'
CREATE TABLE builtin_names AS SELECT DISTINCT UPPER("name") AS n FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE all_names AS SELECT DISTINCT UPPER("name") AS n FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT n FROM builtin_names EXCEPT SELECT n FROM all_names)
SELECT n FROM all_names EXCEPT SELECT n FROM builtin_names
